note: Targeted calibration and identity checks, not a popularity census. Scores remain editorial inferences. Existing lore source_ids were not repurposed as audience measurements.

pop-star-wars-anchor.title: Guinness World Records — Star Wars franchise historical commercial scale
pop-star-wars-anchor.read_scope: Historical franchise valuation/merchandising record; used only as context for the user's explicit top anchor.
pop-star-wars-anchor.limitations: Historical commercial figures are not current audience counts and were not converted into the score. Star Wars = 1 is the user-specified calibration.

pop-banks-estate.title: Iain Banks estate — The Works
pop-banks-estate.read_scope: Bibliography and individual work descriptions, distinguishing Culture books from standalone Banks novels.
pop-banks-estate.limitations: Identity/grouping source; does not measure familiarity or establish a numerical score.

pop-culture-publisher.title: Hachette India — November 2023 publisher sales information
pop-culture-publisher.read_scope: Publisher sales-point snippet describing substantial Banks SF sales and the Culture's genre prominence.
pop-culture-publisher.limitations: Full PDF fetch failed due to content type; no full-document reading claimed. Publisher marketing and aggregate author sales are not a public-recognition survey.

pop-gundam-bandai.title: Bandai Namco — Chief Gundam Officer, Integrated Report 2025
pop-gundam-bandai.read_scope: Long-lived Gundam franchise, international recognition, audience demographics and cross-category activity; historical group sales context.
pop-gundam-bandai.limitations: Company report and commercial signals, not an independent familiarity survey. Supports broad tier placement, not the exact 0.85 value.

pop-sfe-automation.title: The Encyclopedia of Science Fiction — Automation
pop-sfe-automation.read_scope: Historical bibliographic context for Forster, Bellamy, Reynolds and obscure early automation stories, including Mr Jonnemacher's Machine.
pop-sfe-automation.limitations: Documents identity and historical significance. Low current familiarity is an editorial inference, not measured by an encyclopedia mention or search-result count.

pop-sfe-manning.title: The Encyclopedia of Science Fiction — Laurence Manning
pop-sfe-manning.read_scope: The Call of the Mech-Men and its Stranger Club publication/collection context.
pop-sfe-manning.limitations: Bibliographic check only; the low-recognition score remains an editorial inference.

pop-nexus-author.title: Ramez Naam — Books: The Nexus Trilogy
pop-nexus-author.read_scope: Existing registered source title/URL identifies Apex with the Nexus trilogy.
pop-nexus-author.limitations: Not freshly read and not an audience source. Used to avoid confusing unrelated works called Apex.

pop-perry-author.title: Robert Corvus — My contribution to Perry Rhodan
pop-perry-author.read_scope: Contributing author's account of the long-running series, German origins and large cumulative circulation.
pop-perry-author.limitations: Series cumulative issue sales are not unique readers; neither a global audience fraction nor a score formula.

pop-midas-review.title: David Langford — review of Midas World
pop-midas-review.read_scope: Review identifies The Midas Plague and The Man Who Ate the World within the Midas World sequence.
pop-midas-review.limitations: Used for grouping identity, not an audience estimate.

pop-perry-hayakawa.title: Hayakawa Books & Magazines — Rhodan NEO commentary
pop-perry-hayakawa.read_scope: Japanese publisher context and historical print-circulation/readership discussion for Perry Rhodan.
pop-perry-hayakawa.limitations: Historical, region-specific publisher reporting. Supports acknowledging substantial non-Anglophone recognition without equating circulation to universal awareness.
